source_inference: The early-init 4G-mode message follows an INFRACFG_AO bit-13 read and assignment of the file-static enable_4gb selector to 1. The selected source has no later writer to that variable. The v6 HifPdmaStart path issues read/OR/write of ADDR2 bit 0 for both endpoints on every start, independently of the mapped address and selector.
decision: The v6 DMA window has a positive early 4G-mode selector and host-side mapped addresses below 4 GiB while the selected HIF start path issues unconditional ADDR2 bit-32 set writes. This join does not select a mainline DMA mask, offset or upper-bit policy.
limits: The logs do not read back ADDR2 or prove the live INFRACFG bit remained set at transfer time. Source writes and a stable software selector do not identify the effective bus alias of the fixed HIF FIFO or prove transfer routing, data delivery or shared AP-DMA ownership.
